name: RDP Authentication Then Logon
description: Remote Desktop reports a successful network authentication (1149) and a logon follows (4624) — the pair that ties an incoming RDP connection to the session it became. 1149 carries the source address the Security log does not, which is the point of correlating them; it comes from the TerminalServices-RemoteConnectionManager channel, which must be ingested, and it is broad in that it fires for every RDP connection, routine ones included.
